title: Trithemius Corpus: machine-assisted English translations of Latin texts by or associated with Johannes Trithemius
description: Provisional English translations of 29 Latin texts across 47 printed witnesses in the Trithemius Corpus. The project survey located no prior complete published English translation for 23 texts (41 witnesses). Edition records distinguish machine translation, editorial preparation, human review and automated audit coverage. Earlier machine scores are historical. Latin transcription, source scans, and documented corrections support verification of individual passages.
notes: Latin source texts are public domain, with institutional scans cited per work in manifest.json. Machine translations and generated corpus artifacts are released as CC0-1.0. Methodology, documentation, code, and corpus arrangement are licensed CC BY 4.0; see LICENSE.
